title: Disabled Totems
description: Removes the death_protection tag from your totem of undying preventing it from working normally and making it mostly decorational
body:
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/qAm6ACp7Mn8" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>
This is a datapack that I got for the Item Components Mod that removes the death_protection tag from Totems of Undying.

I needed this for my lifesteal server where totems were disabled but still used in the heart crafting recipe. I used the Lifesteal FR mod if you want to know what it was.

THANK YOU
